**Company Background**

Synthetic Devices Inc. designs, manufactures and sells laboratory instruments and the software that runs them, and provides related calibration and repair services.

The Company's fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September. The Company was incorporated in Delaware in 1998.

**Products**

Spectrometers, chromatographs and sample handlers make up most of the Company's net sales; each line is sold with a three-year warranty.

paragraphs.text: Synthetic Devices Inc. designs, manufactures and sells laboratory instruments and the software that runs them, and provides related calibration and repair services.
The Company's fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September. The Company was incorporated in Delaware in 1998.
Spectrometers, chromatographs and sample handlers make up most of the Company's net sales; each line is sold with a three-year warranty.
The Company offers the following services to owners of its instruments:
• Calibration on site or at one of the Company's eleven service centres.
• Repair of instruments sold within the last ten years.
As of September 27, 2025, the Company had approximately 9,400 full-time equivalent employees.
Synthetic Mining plc explores for, mines and processes iron ore, copper and aluminium, and sells them to steelmakers, smelters and manufacturers in Asia, Europe and the Americas.
The Group operates 17 mines in six countries; iron ore from its Pilbara operations provides most of its revenue.
